text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—What dwells within me is akin to a raging 
flame.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"A raging blaze that licks the earth and 
swallows all. A surging, mad flame, never 
satisfied no matter how much it burns."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *Exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Deep inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: âBEGONE!!" hisses!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Alright.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm. I should head back soon.

Our journey through the Twinkle Series 
with Yaeno Muteki is finally about to 
begin!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I look forward to working 
with you today as well.

True to a martial artist, Yaeno Muteki 
gave a polite and respectful greeting.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My warm-up is complete from jogging along 
the road, so I would like to begin 
training immediately.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ......Phew. All done.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I booked this time slot!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I was the one who reserved it! Look, I 
even got the confirmation email!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I got the email too! Huh? Does that mean 
it's double-booked!?"

On the adjacent track, two Umamusume were 
arguing. It seemed a system glitch had 
caused a double-booking for the course.

Neither of them was really in the wrong, 
but the argument gradually grew more 
intense.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Then let's settle it with a race! The 
winner gets the track! How's that?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! I'll win and seize it for 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me. Would you mind if I ask 
something rather unsophisticated?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I have to question whether holding a race 
under these conditions is really wise."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but both of you seem to have 
lost your composure.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you run in a fit of rage, you might end 
up with an unexpected injury.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Getting injured in such a frivolous race 
would undoubtedly lead to endless regret.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In my humble opinion, it would be best to 
conserve that fighting spirit for the 
crucial upcoming race.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: However...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you would like, please feel free to use 
my course. As you can see, I am currently 
resting, so I do not mind if you use it in 
the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? B-But, this has nothing to do 
with you..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, is it possible to swap the 
order of the training exercises?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You can keep borrowing it for a while even 
after the break ends. I'll be back in 30 
minutes, so—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it's fine! I mean…… we'll each use 
half of it too………… right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! If I could just borrow it during 
your break...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your consideration. Until 
later, then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, thank you very much. Thanks 
to you playing along with the story, 
everything was settled amicably.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am honored.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...In the past, whenever I found myself in 
a dispute, I too would immediately 
challenge them to a duel like that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In the past, I was an outlaw, driven 
solely by emotion and desire, using 
violence to force everything to submit to 
my power.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, I trained in the unarmed martial 
art of the Kongo Yae-gaki style under my 
grandfather, the grandmaster, and learned 
the harmony of fire and water.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The raging, fierce instinct "Raging Fire," 
and the calming flow to temper it, "Still 
Water."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bringing both together, channeled into the 
Yaegaki 'Form.' Through the Kongo Yaegaki 
style's ultimate secret, 'Fire and Water 
Unified,' I have acquired the means to 
control my fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Though I am still inexperienced, I take 
pride in having handled myself calmly just 
now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I will continue to devote myself. 
Naturally, the same applies to my races."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Utilizing the 'tactics' I discovered with 
you, Trainer-dono, I shall master 'The 
Unity of Fire and Water.'

"Harnessing her fighting spirit using 
‘tactics’— that was the method the two of 
them discovered before she became her 
trainee."

Yaeno Muteki is usually composed. Yet come 
race time, her innate fiery nature came 
out, and she was jostling purely on 
fighting spirit.

Intrigued by her duality, I reached out to 
her, and from that connection, we began 
working on ways to control her competitive 
spirit—

I have realized that the "forms" of Kongo 
Yaegaki are what one would call "tactics" 
in a race. And by applying these tactics, 
I have succeeded in controlling my 
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The racetrack is an unparalleled arena 
where I can sublimate my fierce fighting 
spirit into pure power."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To achieve results to be proud of in the 
racing world. I want that to be my way of 
repaying my grandparents, who took care of 
me for so many years.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I truly hope so.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best in the Twinkle Series!

Let's do our best in the Twinkle Series, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. First impressions are everything. I 
must run a solid debut race first and 
foremost.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I request that we resume our 
training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-saaan! Are you heading home now?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san. Yes, I am on my way back to 
the dorms.

The one calling out was Sakura Chiyono O. 
An Umamusume reputed to be honest and 
hardworking. She has already debuted and 
belongs to the same generation as Yaeno 
Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You were training until this late? You're 
really fired up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, since my debut has been decided. 
However, doesn't the same apply to you as 
well, Chiyono O-san?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I presume you were also practicing until 
this hour."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ Was it that obvious?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Because at this rate, Yaeno-san and I are 
going to clash in the Twinkle Series, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
As the saying goes: "Fortune favors the 
prepared runner!" If I want to win, I need 
to train hard too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—If we're talking about classmates from 
the same generation, that goes for me too.

The one who arrived was Mejiro Ardan. A 
young lady of the Mejiro family, who I've 
heard is sickly and cannot overexert 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san. Has your debut also been 
decided?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The exact date is still undecided, but... 
I promise, I will make my debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems Ardan-san has made up her 
mind. I have received her resolve loud and 
clear."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If that be so, then when we meet on the 
racetrack one day, let us give it our all 
against one another.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's just what I want.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I won't lose to the two of you either!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Splendid. That will make defeating you 
all the more worthwhile."

Invisible sparks flew between the three of 
their gazes. As if feeling that heat, 
fearless smiles graced their faces.

Thus, Yaeno Muteki's fierce battle began. 
First, I must lead her to victory in her 
Debut race!
